name: La Liberazione
description:
The summer of 2026 some of Sweden's best baroque singers enter Confidencen's stage in Francesca Caccini's *La liberazione di Ruggiero dall’isola d’Alcina* (1625). Lovisa Huledal sings the role of *Nunzia*. Singing are also: Ann Hallenberg, Kristina Hammarström, Martin Vanberg, Minna Tägil and Joseph Mossop. 

This year's *Confidencen Opera & Music Festival* is presented in co-operation with *Den Andra Operan* and has the undertitle "The Female Edition: a celebration to the female composers of opera".
